company.shortDescription: Crimson is a AI productivity platform that allows litigation lawyers to answer case specific questions.
company.description: Crimson is an AI-driven case intelligence platform purpose-built for complex litigation and disputes. By securely parsing thousands of unstructured legal documents, correspondence, and transcripts, it automates deep case analysis, custom drafting, fact-checking, and interactive timeline generation.

productsAndServices.description: An AI case intelligence platform for litigation and arbitration teams that analyzes case files, answers matter-specific questions, finds evidence, builds chronologies, supports drafting, and manages correspondence.
